latest.title: Instantons, indefinite 4-manifolds, and Dehn surgery
latest.abstract: We prove that there exist hyperbolic integer homology spheres with arbitrarily large Dehn surgery number. Previously, no integer homology sphere was known to have a surgery number larger than $2$. Our approach uses Froyshov's invariant $q_3$ of integer homology spheres, which is defined in terms of mod 2 instanton homology. We show that if $W: Y \to Y'$ is a cobordism between integer homology spheres with no $2$-torsion in its first homology, then $-b^+(W) \le q_3(Y') - q_3(Y) \le b^-(W)$. We also extend both $q_3$ and the inequality to rational homology spheres.
latest.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
latest.workSummary: 构造 Dehn 手术数可任意大的双曲整数同调球，并对显式族给出手术数的精确值。关键是以模 2 instanton 同调中的 Frøyshov q3 不变量控制不定四维 cobordism 的正、负 Betti 数。
latest.breakthrough: 从此前未有整数同调球手术数超过 2 的已知例子，提升为显式任意大族，回答 Auckly/Kirby 问题中的重要部分；同时计算 Poincaré 同调球连通和的手术数。
latest.limitations: 核心 cobordism 不等式要求第一整系数同调无 2-挠；不应将引言定理中的 F2-同调球范围无条件推广。67 页技术证明本次核对引言、主定理及证明架构，未逐行复核粘合分析。
latest.priorityReason: 直接突破经典低维拓扑复杂度问题，结果跨度大且带显式构造，q3 的新不等式另具工具价值；列为当日最优先精读之一。
